Fixed. `Error.Unwrap()` in `errors.go` had a pointer receiver while `Error()` has a value receiver, so a non-pointer `gin.Error` value did not implement `interface{ Unwrap() error }` — `errors.Unwrap(Error{...})`, `errors.Is` and `fmt.Errorf("%w", Error{...})` chains all failed to unwrap. Changed the receiver to a value receiver; both `gin.Error` and `*gin.Error` now unwrap correctly, and the full pre-existing test suite still passes.
Got it — investigating the attachment-escaping bug in `context.go`. ETA ~28 min.

Fixed. In `findCaseInsensitivePathRec` (tree.go), the wildcard/param child was fetched as `n.children[0]` instead of the last child. The repo's own invariant (`node` struct comment, `addChild`, and `getValue`) is that the `:param`/`*catchAll` node is always the LAST child, so with multiple children the code read an ordinary child and hit `panic("invalid node type")` (or resolved the wrong node). Now uses `n.children[len(n.children)-1]`; case-insensitive lookup with multiple children + a wildcard resolves correctly and the full pre-existing suite still passes.
